lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me. Most important: if you feel unsafe tonight, call nine one one now. Next: call two one one — two, one, one — and ask for a local domestic violence advocate for a safety plan and a safe Place tonight. If it helps, you can say: “He shoved me last night, and I’m scared to go back home.” You deserve support, and you can take this one step at a time.
